settings.heading: 9g of plant fiber, and we show our math.
settings.text: Prebiotic is a word anyone can print on a can. We back it with a plain nutrition panel that lists every gram, and we put the numbers on each product page.

settings.heading: Three reasons we keep it short

settings.title: Your gut is not a trash can
settings.text: What you sip daily should be something you can describe in plain words.

settings.title: Short lists, big flavor
settings.text: Fewer fillers mean more room for real fruit juice and botanicals.

settings.title: Honest labels
settings.text: Every can lists everything, in order, and no mystery buckets.

settings.heading: Twelve things we will not use.
settings.text: Each entry says what the ingredient does, where it usually hides in soda and why we leave it out.
settings.detail_text: Common in diet sodas, where they stand in for sugar. We sweeten with fruit juice and a little cane sugar instead, so you get flavor without the aftertaste.

settings.name: Artificial sweeteners
settings.detail: Stand in for sugar but leave an aftertaste

settings.name: Benzoate preservatives
settings.detail: Shelf-life helpers that we skip in favor of cold, quick shipping

settings.name: High-fructose corn syrup
settings.detail: A cheap sweetener that fills regular soda

settings.name: Caramel color
settings.detail: Brown dye added for looks, not for taste

settings.name: Artificial flavors
settings.detail: Lab-made flavor we swap for real fruit and botanicals

settings.name: Phosphoric acid
settings.detail: A harsh tang we replace with citrus and apple juice

settings.name: Synthetic dyes
settings.detail: Color added for looks, not for flavor

settings.label: What does 9g of plant fiber mean?
settings.text: Each 12 fl oz can has 9 grams of prebiotic plant fiber, 2 grams of sugar and 35 calories, so it feeds your good bacteria without the sugar crash.

settings.label: Is Fizz good for everyone?
settings.text: Fiber can feel new to some tummies. Start with one can a day, and check with your doctor if you have a health condition.

settings.label: Where can I read a full ingredient list?
settings.text: On every product page, under the ingredients tab, and on the can.
